_instructions: Copy to e6/APPROVAL_RECORD.json and fill EVERY field yourself (the owner). This template is never read as an approval. Each hash must equal the value printed by `python scripts/e6_manifest.py --json` for the frozen inputs (protocol_sha256, scenario_set_sha256, run_plan_sha256, harness_commit, harness_public_ref, harness_tree_sha256); the budget numbers are your own decision (protocol section 8 gives cost evidence only). A value left as NOT_SET, a wrong hash or a non-numeric cap makes the manifest report the record as invalid.
status: NOT_SET  (set to the string APPROVED to authorize)

harness.commit_sha: NOT_SET  (40 hex of the published sanitized-harness commit)
harness.public_ref: NOT_SET  (the public branch or tag name that contains it)
harness.tree_sha256: NOT_SET  (= SANITIZED_MANIFEST.json tree_sha256 of that tree)
